entities.name: Jani Kovačič
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jani Kovačič is a Slovenian professional volleyball player who plays as a libero for ACH Volley and the Slovenia national team. With Slovenia, he competed in the 2015 European Championship. He also represented the country at the 2024 Summer Olympics.
